Eðg1Þ; Eðg2Þ, and Eðg3Þ modes correspond to motion of Y, X (X¼ F, Cl), and O atoms, respectively, in case of YOF, YOCl whereas in case of YOBr, YOI these modes correspond to displacement of the X (X¼Br, I), Y, and O atoms. Similarly the vibrational modes Að11gÞ; Að12gÞ and Að13gÞ belong to the antisymmetric vibration of Y, F, and O atoms, respectively, in case of YOF, whereas in case of YOX (Cl, Br, I) Að11gÞ and Að12gÞ modes correspond to antisymmetric vibration of Y and X (Cl, Br, and I). The B2g mode corresponds to antisymmetric vibration of O atoms.
